## Description

Buy straddles/strangles or related convexity when a volatility/event catalyst may trigger a large move relative to implied pricing.

## Where it may fit

Known catalysts or compression-to-expansion regimes where realized movement can exceed option-implied movement.

## Vehicles

Event-driven and long-volatility funds, tactical option portfolios.

## Required data

Option chain and IV surface, event calendar, expected move, realized volatility, Greeks and spread costs.

## Caveats

Direction can be right but still lose due to theta, IV crush or overpaying for the event.
